meta.name: gohighlevel
meta.description: Operate connected GoHighLevel CRM accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for GoHighLevel, HighLevel, GHL contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars, pipelines, tags, tasks, forms, invoices, products, or approved CRM changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你查看并更新 CRM 里的客户、商机与日程安排
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户和商机都在 CRM 里,想直接对话式地查询和更新
copy.tagline_en: Look up and update CRM contacts, deals, and calendars through chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your contacts and deals live in a CRM and you want to update them by chat

howto.what: Claude 通过 NotFair MCP 连接你的 GoHighLevel 账号,读取联系人、对话、商机、日历等数据;只有你明确要求时才执行写入,并在改完后读回确认。
howto.when: 当你提到 GoHighLevel、GHL 等关键词,或要查看联系人、商机等 CRM 数据、执行已批准的改动时接管。

say.text: 列出我 GoHighLevel 账号里的联系人
say.note: 先做只读查询确认连接

say.text: 为这个联系人创建一个任务
把这个商机移到下一个阶段
say.note: 会先展示改动供你审核

howto.what_en: Claude connects to your GoHighLevel account through the NotFair MCP, reads contacts, conversations, opportunities, and calendars, and writes only when you explicitly ask, then reads back to confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention GoHighLevel, GHL keywords, or ask to view or change CRM data such as contacts or opportunities.

say_en.text: List the contacts in my GoHighLevel account
say_en.note: Runs a read to confirm the connection

say_en.text: Create a task for this contact
Move this opportunity to the next stage
say_en.note: Shows the change for review first
